newsitem.title: USA: VISUAL LISTING SYSTEMS FILES FOR 200,000 SHARES.
newsitem.headline: VISUAL LISTING SYSTEMS FILES FOR 200,000 SHARES.

text.p: Visual Listing Systems Inc said Wednesday it has set an initial public offering of 200,000 shares of common stock at $5 per share.
The offering carries a minimum subscription of 100 shares. The shares are being sold on a "first come, first serve, best efforts" basis, the company said in a statement.
The total maximum offering is $1 million. The company, which has created software for house hunting, said it plans to close the offering on May 31, 1998.
It expects the shares would be listed on the Nasdaq.
